name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build with a compact 4000-unit authoritative arena and a grounded 32-character crowd boundary at radius 4500. The old invisible AreaBarrier actor ring and vertical teleport-bobbing are removed. Crowd NPCs settle on terrain first, then gravity, physics, collision, movement and combat AI are disabled and their final ground transforms are periodically re-pinned. The crowd remains 16 generic villagers plus 16 proven GrassMammoths using the stable UPalNPCManager::SpawnNPCForServer path. No client installation required.
